steps.title: Gather required labware and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: a 7 ml tube rack (24‑slot), a 1 ml autosampler tube rack (24‑slot), a 24‑well laser‑cut acrylic rack, an Opentrons P300‑multi‑channel electronic pipette (GEN2), Opentrons 200 µL filter tip rack, and 24‑well plates. The protocol transfers a variable volume of reagent between 24‑well input plate(s) and 24‑well output plate(s).

steps.title: Load plates onto deck
steps.instruction: Place the input 24‑well plate in deck slot 2 and the corresponding output 24‑well plate in deck slot 5. If the experiment contains more than 48 samples, also place a second input plate in deck slot 3 and its output plate in deck slot 6.

steps.title: Load tip rack
steps.instruction: Load the Opentrons 200 µL filter tip rack into tip position 1 on the deck.
